design_state_declaration.definition: The mathematical, structural, and semantic consistency of the engineering specification has been fully audited and verified. This represents the completion of Milestones V3.4-M and V3.4-N. IT IS STRICTLY A DESIGN STATE AND DOES NOT IMPLY HARDWARE COMMISSIONING OR CAPTURE AUTHORIZATION.

PLANNED.definition: Initial facility requirements, sensor configurations, and trial protocols drafted.

INSTALLATION_READY.definition: Facility leased; structural trusses mounted; sensors, PTP grandmaster, network, and storage physically staged.

COMMISSIONING.definition: Active on-site hardware commissioning (Gates C1 through C9) underway: PTP lock, camera alignment, CAN decoding, illuminance measurement, and E-Stop oscilloscope verification.

INSTRUMENTATION_READY_FOR_CAPTURE.definition: All physical Pre-Capture Commissioning Gates (C1 through C9) verified PASS on physical hardware. Instrumentation certified capable of capturing valid multi-modal data.

PHYSICAL_CAPTURE_AUTHORIZED.definition: Formal operational authorization granted following on-site safety walkthrough, Safety Marshal E-Stop test, and bilateral site agreement execution.

CAPTURE_IN_PROGRESS.definition: Active data acquisition during a controlled trial run (L01-L09) or naturalistic shift under live Safety Marshal supervision.

CAPTURE_ABORTED.definition: Active trial terminated due to Safety Abort or Data Invalidation Abort.

ABORTED_RUN_ARCHIVED.definition: Aborted run package quarantined in outputs/aborted_runs/ with diagnostic logs. Permanently marked NON_EVIDENTIARY; cannot advance to review or GT.

CAPTURE_COMPLETED.definition: Trial run completed nominally with zero safety or data abort conditions tripped.
CAPTURE_COMPLETED.next_step: Execution of Post-Capture Data Quality Gates D1 through D6

DATASET_READY_FOR_REVIEW.definition: Post-capture gates D1 through D6 verified PASS; sanitized review packages compiled with zero algorithmic scores or model outputs.

VALIDATION_READY.definition: Double-blind human panel adjudication complete; inter-rater agreement verified; Ground Truth committed with cryptographic signoff.

authoritative_transitions.condition: Facility lease executed & hardware staged on site
Rigging, cabling, and power connections complete
Pre-Capture Commissioning Gates C1 through C9 = PASS
Hardware fault or mechanical remount required
Safety Marshal site walkthrough, E-Stop test, and labor privacy signoff
Session armed by Safety Marshal & Data Operations Lead
Safety Abort or Data Invalidation Abort triggered
Root cause logged; fault cleared; C1-C9 re-verified
Run finishes nominally with zero abort conditions tripped

strictly_forbidden_shortcuts.rule: CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Design completeness is a documentation state only. Cannot declare instrumentation ready without physical hardware installation and passing Gates C1-C9 on physical hardware.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Design completeness does NOT grant authorization for physical capture. Requires physical hardware deployment, commissioning, and Safety Marshal approval.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Raw unadjudicated captures cannot establish validation without Post-Capture Gates D1-D6 and sanitized human GT review.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Aborted runs are strictly non-evidentiary and cannot be reviewed as valid experimental data.
